title: Prepare and insert the SIM card
goal: Prepare a Nano-SIM so the Pro-finder can register on the mobile network, then insert it into the module.
prerequisites: You have a network-activated Nano-SIM card.
You have a mobile phone that lets you change the SIM-card settings.
The Pro-finder is disconnected from power and its circuit board is accessible.

warnings.text: The SIM-card PIN request must be disabled. Without this step the module will not register on the network, and the Status-LED will flash alternately red and green.
If an iPhone is used, iMessages must be disabled while carrying out steps 1 to 4.

sources.region: Section 2.1, red caution block below the list of steps

steps.text: Insert the SIM card into a mobile device.

sources.region: Section 2.1, introduction to the list of steps

steps.expected: The card can be used without entering a PIN.

steps.text: Disable voicemail and all call forwarding.
Disable all convenience services, including callback requests by SMS and reminders by SMS.
Enable roaming if it is not enabled by default.
steps.expected: The card can register on other networks, which the source requires for locating the vehicle abroad.

steps.text: Remove the SIM card from the mobile device.
Insert the card into the holder on the Pro-finder circuit board and lock the holder.
steps.expected: The holder is closed and the card is secure.

sources.region: Section 2.2, first paragraph and circuit-board photograph

expected_result: The prepared Nano-SIM is locked into the Pro-finder module. After power is connected, the Status-LED briefly flashes red and then flashes yellow-green.

error_cases.correction: The SIM card is missing or defective. Check that a working Nano-SIM is inserted correctly and that the holder is locked.

error_cases.problem: The Status-LED flashes alternately red and green.
error_cases.correction: The SIM-card PIN has not been disabled and the module is not ready for use. Insert the card into a mobile phone again and disable the PIN request.

error_cases.problem: A prepaid card cannot be topped up or checked without removing it.
error_cases.correction: Choose a prepaid card that can be topped up from another mobile phone or, for example, at a cash machine without removing it from the device.

figures.alt: Close-up of the Pro-finder circuit board with the SIM-card holder open and an ESD warning symbol.
figures.long_description: Colour photograph of the green circuit board. At the upper left is a white Nano-SIM whose cut-off corner indicates the insertion direction. Below it is the open metal card holder with visible contacts. Beside it is a yellow electrostatic-discharge warning symbol, and the radio module is visible on the right.
steps_text: Align the cut-off corner of the Nano-SIM with the holder and insert the card.

sources.region: Sections 2.1 “SIM-Karte konfigurieren” and 2.2 “SIM-Karte ins Pro-finder-Modul einsetzen”
